column1: # The realtime bench's stage rows (stage.sh): a composition with one control in its defaultProps, the value it is
# changed to on the running stage, the frame compared and how many draws of it are captured. Tab-separated:
#   path      the composition, from the repo root (or absolute: a copy outside the repo)
#   prop      the control, a key of its <Composition defaultProps>
#   a         its value as written (as the source spells it)
#   b         the value set with stage.props, as JSON (and written into the copy's defaultProps as spelled)
#   updates   draws of the frame captured (1 for a frame drawn at once; many for ray-traced light converging)
#   seed      optional: RAEA_SEED for the window, so the live session takes the render's seed
